definition: The group of words that name these groups themselves, one for each family the glossary files its words under. Each heads its group on the Glossary page.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`family` holds the families themselves, which head the Glossary page's groups", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
